question: Is the three-versus-five-exposure protocol scattered across plan-associated actions, or aligned with camera and contiguous time regimes?
terminal_objective: Deduplicate the many-to-many plan ledger to unique associated actions, measure bracket-length concentration by camera and temporal run, and quantify the product-share shift without treating a fitted description as a predictive or causal model.
method: Replay Stage 11G, take the union of action IDs with at least one nonblank Stage 10Z plan membership, join each action once to the Stage 10O relationship manifest, order actions within camera by action start, and count exposure-count transitions. Compare the five-exposure regime's action share with its flat-product share. Do not sum overlapping plan windows.
authority: Private local relationship and accounting analysis only. No pixels, plan-partition claim, held-out classifier claim, causal target/content claim, actual sampler claim, observed model behavior, deletion recommendation, universal weighting correction, archive-wide extrapolation, novelty, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 11H may establish that the deduplicated union of plan-associated actions contains 994 three-exposure and 546 five-exposure actions; five-exposure actions are 35.455% of actions but 47.794% of flat products. It may establish that camera 3920019's 156 associated actions are all five-exposure and rise from 10.130% of actions to 13.655% of flat products, camera 3500017's seven are all three-exposure, and camera 3500015's 390 five-exposure actions form one contiguous in-sample time run between three-exposure runs. It cannot treat plan memberships as a partition, call the fitted camera/time description held out or generalizable, make bracket length a target or content label, assert an actual sampler or observed model bias, recommend discarding intentional exposures, nominate a universal correction, extend beyond admitted records, or make a novelty, priority, or physical-science claim.

next_step_logic.if_public_analysis_is_selected: Say that acquisition policy is aligned with operational context, so flat-product prominence can inherit camera/time structure; retain the exact in-sample and noncausal limits.
next_step_logic.if_a_model_task_is_selected: Preserve all intentional bracket exposures, but declare the estimand and report camera, time regime, bracket length, action, and event structure in sampling and evaluation.
next_step_logic.if_a_causal_or_predictive_claim_is_propo: Stop; the camera/time rule was derived and checked on the same plan-associated cohort.
next_step_logic.if_windows_are_aggregated: Stop and use the deduplicated action union or Stage 10Z ledger.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised action oracle, plan ledger, relationship manifest, admitted window set, or actual model sampler.
